mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comments (post_id, user_id, body) VALUES (#{postId}, #{userId}, #{body})
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.post_id, c.user_id, c.body, c.created_at, u.username AS author_username, u.display_name AS author_display_name, u.avatar_key AS author_avatar_key FROM comments c JOIN users u ON u.id = c.user_id JOIN posts p ON p.id = c.post_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE c.id = #{id} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE comments SET deleted_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
